response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_overspend FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS overall_remaining FROM ev) SELECT ev.status, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ev.avg_overspend) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) / (SELECT overall_remaining FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall FROM ev GROUP BY ev.status
